'''2012 European Championship Casper Jørgensen LS The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Casper Jørgensen]] at [[2012 European Championship]] (European Championship).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|The Hyperdrive Generator's Gone / We'll Need A New One|Cor-L-thehyperdrivegeneratorsgone.gif}}
* '''Username:''' Aermet69
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' European Championship
